name: LLM-supported translation
summary: POST /translator/text/translate with targets[].deploymentName='{conn}/{model}' to use an LLM for translation.
description: The Translator API `POST /translate?api-version=2026-06-06` accepts `targets[].deploymentName` to choose the LLM used for each target language. That nested deployment slot would need to parse `{connection}/{deployment}` for APIM-routed LLM translation.
notes:
BYOM does not work: the Translator API treats the entire `{connection}/{model}` string as a literal deployment name and fails to look it up.

Server error verbatim:

> `HTTP 400: Failed to get information on deployment apim-<gateway>/gpt-4o-mini. Please double check that the deployment exists.`

Calls use `FOUNDRY_ACCOUNT_ENDPOINT` (account-level, not project-level) and require the `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region` header. The BYOM prefix reaches the Translator surface intact but Translator does not implement the prefix-parsing contract.
